result: At pinned commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, discover_startup handles a successful DiscoverResult by selecting a mutually supported protocol version, calling peer.set_peer_info(ServerPeerInfo::from_discover_result(selected, result)), installing ClientRequestMetadata with that selected protocol version plus client info/capabilities, and returning DiscoverOutcome::Modern. Thus, within this exact implementation path, successful Discover startup explicitly installs peer state and per-request client metadata and enters the running service without invoking legacy Initialize.
